statement: For the Sp4 diagonal D with u1=5, u2=3 at N=53 (coset size 8: k in {0,13,26,39}, l in {0,26}), the coset-restricted second moment A_S(q1,q2) = sum_{coset}|<chi|U_D Q(q1,q2)|chi>|^2 = 8/2809 = |coset|/G EXACTLY for every 2-parameter level-set phase (q1,q2) — the rank-2 analogue of the cat-map Lemma 91.1 q-independence, now with a NONTRIVIAL coset and the full 2-parameter deformation.
significance: the G0 mechanism (flatness of the coupled energy) is EXACT at rank 2 with a nontrivial character coset — the first concrete Sp4 evidence.  The 8/2809 value = |coset|/G follows from the coset characters being D-fixed: <chi|U_D Q|chi> is the q-weighted character sum, constant in q over the coset.
